Trump Announces 50% Tariff on Steel & Aluminum: Breaking News (May 31–June 2, 2025)

![Trump's Truth Social Post](figures/Trump%20tweet%20May%2031%20on%20steel%20escalation.png)

📌 Key Announcement

- Tariff Increase: 50% on imported steel and aluminum (up from 25%).
- Effective Date: June 4, 2025.
- Platform: Announced via [Truth Social](https://truthsocial.com/).
- Rationale: Protect U.S. industries and workers; Trump stated:
   "At 25%, [trading partners] can sorta get over that fence. At 50%, nobody’s getting over that fence."

🌍 Global Reactions

1. European Union
Threatened countermeasures ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/eu-commission-strongly-regrets-announced-increase-us-steel-tariffs-2025-05-31/)).
   Called the move "economic aggression."
2. Markets
- 📈 Steel stocks surged (e.g., Cleveland-Cliffs, U.S. Steel).
- 📉 Auto stocks fell (Ford, GM) over cost concerns ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/stock-market-today-trump-tariffs-trade-war-06-02-2025/card/auto-stocks-fall-after-trump-moves-to-double-steel-and-aluminum-tariffs-fQMV6HpzCPyNqQLFXdlY)).
- Global indices dipped amid trade war fears ([CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2025/06/02/business/global-stocks-fall-trump-tariff-reignite-intl)).

⚡ Expected Impacts

| Sector             | Effect                                 |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------|
| U.S. Steelmakers   | Short-term profit surge                |
| Automakers         | Higher production costs                 |
| Consumers          | Price hikes for steel/aluminum products |
| Global Trade       | Retaliatory tariffs likely              |
